TO CONSIDER

Adjectives are divided into two groups: / Short (1 or 2 syllables) / Long (2 or more syllables).
Short adjectives take the –est particles: Joe is the tallest in his family.
Long adjectives take the most  particle: It is the most expensive restaurant in the city.
Short adjectives that finish in –y change to I + est: She is the prettiest at school.
There are irregular adjectives: Good – Better than – The Best / Bad – Worse than – The Worst.
The superlative for less than is: The least. E.G: That is the least of my worries.
ABSOLUTE adjectives do not take superlative level

My Best Friend
My best friend, Cloe, lives in the most wonderful city of all times. She lives in Seoul where the greatest technological advances occur every day. Where does she live?
Which is the most wonderful city of all times?
When do the greatest technological advances occur there?
Where does her best friend study?

texts: We use superlatives when we want to point out one person / place / object /matter etc. among others (from a group) because of its particular characteristics.
Adjectives are used in this topic but they take a new form. Check the following examples.
Statements
Questions
Negative statements
Jill is the most attractive in her class.
Is Jill the most attractive in her class?
Jill is not the most attractive in her class.
China is one of the biggest countries in Asia.
Is China one of the  biggest countries in Asia?
China is not one of the biggest countries in Asia.
Computers are among the most expensive devices nowadays.
Are computers among the most expensive devices nowadays?
Computers are not among the most expensive devices nowadays.

texts: Language Targets
Aspects
Examples
Point out people among a group.
Jake is the smallest at home. / He seems to be the most interesting person in his family.
State one place’s uniqueness.
This is the biggest around here. /  Los Angeles is one of  the most expensive cities in USA.
Denote specificity in one object.
Your bag is the best here. / Their car seems to be the most luxurious in the club.
Describe Situations.
This is the worst problem of the family. / They have now the most challenging situation of all.
Superlatives can deal with different aspects. they can also be used at any tense.
TO CONSIDER
When using superlatives, you need to have always a context where the person /place /object /situation etc. stands out from.

published.title: Language Targets
visibleTexts: Language Targets

Aspects Examples 1 Point out people among a group. Jake is the smallest at home. / He seems to be the most interesting person in his family. 2 State one place’s uniqueness. This is the biggest around here. / Los Angeles is one of the most expensive cities in USA. 3 Denote specificity in one object. Your bag is the best here. / Their car seems to be the most luxurious in the club. 4 Describe Situations. This is the worst problem of the family. / They have now the most challenging situation of all.
Superlatives can deal with different aspects. they can also be used at any tense.
TO CONSIDER When using superlatives, you need to have always a context where the person /place /object /situation etc. stands out from.

C. Read the following paragraph and identify where the superlatives are. After that, Answer the questions next to it. Finally, read it aloud with your teacher.
My Best Friend

My best friend, Cloe, lives in the most wonderful city of all times. She lives in Seoul where the greatest technological advances occur every day. She studies in one of the biggest designing institute of the city and it has the best reputation of the local people. I want to visit her, but right now I have the worst economic situation ever. However, she has the most amazing job too, so she wants to pay for my plane ticket, I am so excited!
Who is her best friend?
Where does she live?
Which is the most wonderful city of all times?
When do the greatest technological advances occur there?
Where does her best friend study?
Does it have a good reputation?
Why doesn’t she visit her best friend?
Does her best friend have a good job?
